report.source_text: The patient underwent a standard three-port 25-gauge pars plana vitrectomy in the left eye first. After core vitrectomy, intravitreal triamcinolone acetonide was injected to stain posterior cortical vitreous and induce posterior vitreous detachment. Air–fluid exchange was done, and ILM was stained with brilliant blue green. ILM peeling was carried out about 2-disc diameters around the macular hole. A non-expansile mixture of 14% C3F8 Gas tamponade was given. The patient was asked to maintain a face-down position for 10 hours a day for 7 days. To minimise the risks associated with bilateral simultaneous surgery, the surgery for the right eye was performed 4 weeks later.

clinician.final_diagnosis: Bilateral idiopathic macular hole in a young female
clinician.trajectory_summary: A woman in her early 30s presented to the retina clinic with a 6-month history of progressive central vision loss and metamorphopsia in both eyes. She had no significant past medical or ocular history and denied any history of trauma. On initial examination, best-corrected visual acuity was OD 6/24 N8 and OS 4/60, with mild myopia (OD −3.50/−2.00 × 10°; OS −4.00/−1.00 × 180°). Fundoscopic examination revealed bilateral full-thickness macular holes with mild temporal peripapillary atrophy in the right eye and no peripheral retinal breaks, confirmed by spectral domain OCT. The diagnosis of idiopathic bilateral macular holes was supported by the absence of secondary causes (no high myopia, no trauma history, no systemic disease). The patient underwent sequential 25-gauge pars plana vitrectomy with internal limiting membrane peeling and 14% C3F8 gas tamponade for both eyes (left eye first, right eye 4 weeks later). Post-operative outcomes showed significant visual improvement: at 2 weeks, visual acuity improved to OD 6/9 and OS 6/18p; at 10 weeks, visual acuity further improved to OD 6/9p N6 and OS 6/9 N6. Post-operative OCT demonstrated type 2A closure of the macular hole in the right eye and type 1B closure in the left eye, with restoration of foveal contour in both eyes.
